routeSelectionNote: The four statutory disposition categories of § 99-19-71(4) are rendered as the participant's own marks and exactly one is marked, because which non-conviction ending is true lives on the participant's own record and the route does not determine it — the route covers all four. No 'with prejudice' qualifier is added unless the participant's own order says so, because the archived Fourth District model's qualifier is narrower than the statute requires. The certificate's manner-of-delivery marks are the participant's own act at service time.
